name: distorted-glass
title: Distorted Glass
blurb: Frosted glass overlay with fractal noise distortion via SVG filter.
description: Decorative glass effect combining SVG feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap with a repeating radial gradient and backdrop blur. Static and hidden below xl breakpoint.
use_when: Decorative glass overlay at the base of a hero or banner section to add polish.
avoid_when: When the component must be responsive below xl — it is display-hidden on smaller screens.
a11y: Purely decorative overlay with pointer-events-none. No interactive elements or semantic content.
